ZANIK_ENABLED.title: Enable Zanik
ZANIK_ENABLED.description: Master switch for the entire mod. When disabled, the launcher starts the official game server without loading Zanik; installed files and persistent data are preserved.

STATUS_PORT.title: Zanik website TCP port
STATUS_PORT.description: Separately allocated and open TCP port for the Zanik website. Do not use the Dragonwilds game port.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.title: Public website URL
PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Externally reachable website address used for links, including its public port when needed.

ADMIN_COOKIE_NAME.title: Administrator cookie name
ADMIN_COOKIE_NAME.description: Browser cookie name for administrator sessions.

FEATURE_PLAYER_STATUS.title: Player status
FEATURE_PLAYER_STATUS.description: Track connected players and status information.

FEATURE_MAP.title: Map and catalogs
FEATURE_MAP.description: Serve the map and generated catalogs.

FEATURE_ADMIN_READ.title: Read-only administration
FEATURE_ADMIN_READ.description: Allow authenticated administrators to inspect server data.

FEATURE_ADMIN_RECIPE_SETTINGS.title: Recipe administration
FEATURE_ADMIN_RECIPE_SETTINGS.description: Allow administrators to change recipe unlock settings.

FEATURE_ADMIN_TELEPORT.title: Administrator teleport
FEATURE_ADMIN_TELEPORT.description: Allow authenticated player, player-built lodestone, fixed nodestone, storage, gravestone, and quest-step teleports.

FEATURE_QOL_AUTO_COMPOST.title: Automatic compost equipment (incomplete)
FEATURE_QOL_AUTO_COMPOST.description: Reserved for an unfinished feature with no deployable server integration. Keep this disabled.
